nodes.name: ReadUserRequest
nodes.role: read the user's banking request naming the new address, the landlord account, the rent amount, and the incoming 10.00 payment to refund

nodes.name: UpdateAccountAddress
nodes.role: change the address on the user's account to the new address the request gives

nodes.name: ReadStandingOrders
nodes.role: list the user's existing standing orders

nodes.name: UpdateRentStandingOrder
nodes.role: set the rent standing order to pay the landlord account the rent amount the request gives

nodes.name: FindFriendPayment
nodes.role: locate the 10.00 incoming payment from the user's friend that the request names

nodes.name: RefundFriendPayment
nodes.role: return the located 10.00 payment to the friend who sent it

nodes.name: ReportResults
nodes.role: summarize the address change, the updated standing orders, and the refund outcome for the user
